thaumiclegacy.title: Thaumic Legacy
message.thaumiclegacy.already_observed: This specimen is already recorded in your research journal.
message.thaumiclegacy.no_target: Aim at nearby stone, a torch, or an oak log to record a specimen.
message.thaumiclegacy.research_unlocked: New entry in your research journal: Comparing Specimens.
screen.thaumiclegacy.journal.empty: Use the field lens on stone, a torch, or an oak log. New observations will appear here.
screen.thaumiclegacy.journal.locked.body: Record any two different specimens to open this entry.
screen.thaumiclegacy.journal.unlocked.bo: Stone holds its shape, flame gives off heat, and wood preserves the shape of its growth. Compare your first two specimens with the third to see a different material trait.
observation.minecraft.stone: Rigidity. The fracture runs across the grain. The stone resisted evenly in every direction.
observation.minecraft.torch: Warmth. Heat rises above the wick while light spreads to either side.
observation.minecraft.oak_log: Growth. The grain runs along the trunk. The rings on the cut face mark each season of growth.
